title: 第二十六章 上古小秘境第二十五章 浮生若梦二
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
这话听着莫名有些怪异，谢清猗不自觉地颦蹙起眉头，嗓音里有自己不自知的娇柔，下意识解释着：“你乱讲，不许污蔑我，我才不愿与他一路。”
她顿了顿，似乎不能只说这一句，也不知自己为何要解释这么多：“之前在飞舟上，我便极力避着和他一路，是他非要拉着我不放。”
话一出口，心头竟莫名一松，却也来不及细想自己刚刚为何怕对方误解。
玉简那头静默了片刻，再次响起的声音里，那冷硬的语气似乎融化了些许，声音里带着一丝几不可察的轻笑：“嗯。我来秘境寻你。”
听闻他要来，谢清猗心口一跳，唇角不自觉微微扬起，带上了未察觉的关切：“那你，务必小心，外头的毒瘴林很危险。”
这次识海中清晰地传来慕宸一声很轻地低笑，清冽好听的嗓音在她识海中打转：“嗯，知道了。”
随即，玉简的联络便被对方干脆地掐断。
千沐妍自踏入句余山后，一路都未与谢清猗搭话，此刻见她唇边噙着一抹若有似无的笑意，终究按捺不住，语带讥诮地开口：“眼下境况凶险，多少同门已然牺牲，不知谢师姐是因何事，竟还能笑得出来？”
谢清猗只觉得眉心抽抽，自己满头问号，她转头无语的看向对方，眼神轻瞥了她一眼，女主，你有什么大病，没事找茬，就这么想和她这个恶毒女配，扯不开关系吗？
心念瞬转间，面上却依旧如寻常，她将声音略略提高，语速不急不缓：“我等此番进入秘境，若能有所斩获，拔得头筹，才不辜负仙府多年的悉心栽培，亦是对我等现阶段修行成果的最好印证。”
顿了顿，她目光坦然扫过四周弟子，最终落回千沐妍面上，继续道：“至于不幸罹难的同门，我心中自然万分沉痛。正是因我深信，在司师兄的引领下，我等必能取得秘宝，不负逝者所托，心中方觉有所依托，神色才不似那般沉重罢了。”
说罢，她刚才的发言地时候就不停的脑补，好像什么x商给人洗脑的大会，给他们打鸡血呢。随即又看向千沐妍，见对方瞥过头不看她。
她鼻腔轻轻哼了声，至于笑？她自然是绝不会承认的，只是有些气恼，这女主怎么总是盯着她啊，真晦气！
谢清猗心底掠过一丝冷嘲，面上却依旧温和，看向千沐妍道，不紧不慢地说道：“倒是千师妹，稍后若遇险境，望你稍安勿躁，行事前多思量，莫要再如先前那般，再让大家分心照看。”
“哦，对了，千师妹先前在毒瘴林中受惊不小，此刻脸色仍有些苍白，可需先服一粒补魂丹压压惊？”她眼波划过一抹流光，唇角微扬。
她又看向众弟子，眸光在千沐妍涨红的脸上掠过：“此地危机四伏，过大的声响恐生不测，平白为队伍招致麻烦，还望诸位留意。”
司楚白目光落在谢清猗身上，眸光深了几分，又随着对方的眼神落在千沐妍身上，见对方面颊倏然通红，最后面容微冷，随即便移开了。
他神色未变，适时开口，声线沉稳：“谢师妹所言极是。既然已有同门付出代价，我等更当全力以赴，方不负他们所托。”
随后他话音微转，不着痕迹地将众人视线引向前路：“前方境况恐更为诡谲复杂，所有人务必紧跟，不得有失。”
千沐妍的脸色倏地涨红，随即又血色尽褪，一阵红一阵白，精彩纷呈。她先是难以置信地，带着深深幽怨凝望了一眼司楚白决绝的背影，最终将目光转向谢清猗时，那眼中已全然不加掩饰，满是憎恨。

余下的弟子们此刻紧紧追随着司楚白，刚才那一场机锋，并未引起他们太多不满情绪，反而纷纷交换着兴奋的眼神，好似先前因牺牲而带来的压抑一扫而空。
谢清猗见他们情绪高涨，眼中的阴霾被一股昂扬的斗志所取代，这才松了口气。
她察觉到身后的弟子们，像是多了一份对前路的期待，甚至有人不自觉地摩拳擦掌，跃跃欲试的模样，人群中响起些许兴奋的低语，士气明显为之一振。
不多时，众人行至一处岔路，司楚白审视片刻，果断选择了右侧路径。谢清猗的目光则悄然投向左侧那条更为幽深的路径，心念微动，随即按下思绪，此刻并非好时机，还是且先随行，再寻良机脱离大部队。
随着深入，她发觉句余山秘境果然名不虚传，蕴藏着大量仙金，灵玉与稀有矿石。
众人途经一片质如叠岩的山石区时，便从中采集到不少蕴含风灵之力的虎风石，此物可做疾行符，她也跟着挖掘了不少。
不多时，又行至怪石嶙峋的幽深洞穴，在岩壁上发现了沉黯厚重，隐隐发亮的乌晶铜。
直至循着水声来到一处地下水源旁，终于寻得了那如水波流转，光华内蕴的海龙仙金。
不仅如此，沿途石缝与崖壁间，更是生长着繁星点点的栊星草与生机蓬勃的景天草等诸多灵植，收获可谓颇丰。
谢清猗心中忽然忆起这秘境中似乎生有一种诡谲的鬼草，其外形与常见的龙骨草几乎一致，难以分辨。
据慕宸所赠的《混元丹诀》记载，此物阴毒无比，一旦触碰，初时令人心神亢奋，继而便会陷入癫狂，直至理智尽失。
她脑海中清晰浮现出古籍中描绘的二者形貌，深知其威力，不由得眉心轻蹙，可是此刻却无法直接提醒大家。
眼见同门四下采集，她的目光不由自主地追随他们的动作，心头仿佛被一只无形的手紧紧攥住，唯恐有人误触灾厄。
不过好在安然无事，她的心神便微微松下，行过这段相对平静的路程，收获颇丰之际，眼前豁然开朗，来到一处空旷地带。
却见前方幽蓝色的火光闪烁，竟是成群有组织地飞舞着，而这外形奇特的飞蚁，周身缠绕着幽蓝色火焰，犹如一片移动的火海，猛烈围攻着几名散修。
那火焰触物即燃，却不发热反带着阴寒之气，逼得散修们身心俱疲。
“不好，是蚀灵蚁！诸位小心！”远处骤然出现的另一队人马，正是灵霄神宫弟子，为首一名男修面无血色，声音中带着难以抑制的惶恐。
然而此时已为时已晚，蚀灵蚁的数量多得令人头皮发麻，遮天蔽日般从四面八方涌来。
各派修士与散修虽奋力催动本门术法，一时之间火光，雷光，剑光交织乱闪，成片的蚀灵蚁在轰鸣中化为飞灰。
击杀一片又一片，奈何蚀灵蚁群数量太过庞大，竟似无穷无尽，依旧前仆后继地扑上，他们的努力犹如杯水车薪。

These words sounded inexplicably weird. Xie Qingyi frowned unconsciously. There was a softness in his voice that he didn't know he had, and he subconsciously explained: "You are talking nonsense. Don't slander me. I don't want to be with him."
She paused, as if she couldn't just say this sentence, and she didn't know why she had to explain so much: "I tried my best to avoid being with him on the flying boat, but he insisted on holding me back."
As soon as the words came out, I felt inexplicably relieved, but I didn't have time to think about why I was afraid of being misunderstood.
There was silence on the other end of the jade slip for a moment. When the voice came out again, the cold tone seemed to have melted a little, and there was an almost imperceptible chuckle in the voice: "Yes. I came to the secret realm to find you."
Hearing that he was coming, Xie Qingyi's heart skipped a beat, and the corners of his lips raised slightly unconsciously, with unnoticed concern: "Then you must be careful, the poisonous miasma forest outside is very dangerous."
This time, a soft chuckle from Mu Chen was clearly heard in her consciousness, and the clear and pleasant voice swirled in her consciousness: "Yes, I understand."
Immediately, Yu Jian's contact was simply cut off by the other party.
Qian Muyan hadn't spoken to Xie Qingyi all the way since she stepped into Juyu Mountain. Now she saw a faint smile on her lips. She couldn't hold it back and spoke sarcastically: "The current situation is dangerous and many of our classmates have already sacrificed. I wonder why Senior Sister Xie can still laugh?"
Xie Qingyi felt her brows twitching, and her head was full of questions. She turned to look at the other party speechlessly, and glanced at her, heroine, what's wrong with you, why are you looking for trouble? Do you really want to have nothing to do with her, a vicious female partner?
Her thoughts were fleeting, but her face remained as usual. She raised her voice slightly and spoke at a leisurely pace: "We enter the secret realm this time. If we can gain something and come out on top, we will be able to live up to the Xian Mansion's many years of careful cultivation. This will also be the best confirmation of our current cultivation achievements."
After a pause, her eyes calmly scanned the surrounding disciples, and finally returned to Qian Muyan, and continued: "As for the unfortunate fellow disciples who died, my heart is naturally very sad. It is precisely because I firmly believe that under the guidance of Senior Brother Si, we will be able to obtain the secret treasure and live up to the trust of the deceased, so I feel that I have something to rely on, and my expression is not so heavy."
Having said that, she kept thinking about what she just said, as if it was some kind of conference where sex dealers brainwash people and give them chicken blood. Then he looked at Qian Muyan and saw that the other party glanced away from her.
She snorted softly through her nose. As for laughing? Of course she would never admit it, but she was just a little annoyed. Why was the heroine always staring at her? What a bad luck!
A hint of cynicism flashed through Xie Qingyi's heart, but his face remained gentle. He looked at Qian Muyan and said unhurriedly: "Junior sister Qian, if you are in danger later, I hope you will be calm and think carefully before acting. Don't let everyone distract you like before."
"Oh, by the way, Junior Sister Qian was quite frightened in the poisonous miasma forest before, and her face is still a little pale now. Do you need to take a soul-replenishing pill first to calm down the shock?" There was a flash of light in her eyes, and the corners of her lips were raised slightly.
She looked at the disciples again, her eyes passing over Qian Muyan's flushed face: "This place is full of dangers. Excessive noise may cause accidents and cause trouble for the team. I hope you will pay attention."
Si Chubai's eyes fell on Xie Qingyi, his eyes deepened a little, and then he followed the other person's eyes to Qian Muyan. He saw that the other person's cheeks suddenly turned red, and finally his face was slightly cold, and then he moved away.
His expression did not change, and he spoke at the right time, with a steady voice: "Junior Sister Xie is absolutely right. Since our fellow disciples have paid the price, we should go all out to live up to their trust."
Then he changed his voice slightly and directed everyone's attention forward without leaving any trace: "The situation ahead may be more bizarre and complicated. Everyone must follow closely and make sure there is no loss."
Qian Muyan's face suddenly turned red, and then the color faded away, turning red and white., wonderful and exciting. She first stared at Si Chubai Juejue's back in disbelief and with deep resentment. When she finally turned her gaze to Xie Qingyi, her eyes were completely undisguised and full of hatred.
The remaining disciples were following Si Chubai closely at this moment. The confrontation just now did not cause them too much dissatisfaction. Instead, they all exchanged excited looks, as if the depression caused by the previous sacrifice had been swept away.
Xie Qingyi breathed a sigh of relief when he saw that their emotions were high and the haze in their eyes was replaced by a high spirit of fighting.
She noticed that the disciples behind her seemed to have more expectations for the future. Some were even gearing up unconsciously and eager to try. There were some excited whispers in the crowd, and their morale was obviously boosted.
Not long after, everyone came to a fork in the road. Si Chubai examined it for a moment and decisively chose the right path. Xie Qingyi's eyes quietly turned to the deeper path on the left. His mind moved slightly, and he immediately suppressed his thoughts. It was not a good time at the moment, so he would go with him first, and then look for a good opportunity to escape from the large army.
As she went deeper, she discovered that the secret realm of Juyu Mountain was indeed well-deserved, containing a large amount of fairy gold, spiritual jade and rare ores.
When the group passed by a rocky area that was as solid as stacked rocks, they collected a lot of tiger wind stones that contained the power of the wind spirit. These stones could be used as speed talismans, and she also dug up a lot of them.
Not long after, we walked to a deep cave with jagged rocks and found dark, thick, and faintly shiny black crystal copper on the rock wall.
Until he followed the sound of water to an underground water source, and finally found the sea dragon immortal gold that was flowing like water waves and filled with brilliance.
Not only that, but among the stone crevices and cliffs along the way, there are many spiritual plants such as starry starry grass and vibrant sedum grass, which can be said to be a bountiful harvest.
Xie Qingyi suddenly remembered that there seemed to be a strange ghost grass growing in this secret realm. Its appearance was almost the same as the common dragon bone grass, making it difficult to distinguish.
According to the "Hunyuan Dan Jue" given by Mu Chen, this thing is extremely poisonous. Once touched, it will make people excited at first, and then they will fall into madness until they lose all reason.
The two descriptions described in ancient books clearly appeared in her mind, and she knew their power, and she couldn't help but frown, but she couldn't remind everyone directly at this moment.
Seeing her fellow students looking around for food, she could not help but follow their movements with her eyes, as if her heart was tightly grasped by an invisible hand, lest anyone accidentally encounter disaster.
Fortunately, she was safe, so her mind relaxed slightly. After walking through this relatively peaceful journey, and when she gained a lot, her eyes suddenly opened up and she came to an open area.
However, they saw the flickering blue fire in front of them, flying in groups in an organized manner. The strange-looking flying ants were surrounded by blue flames, like a moving sea of ​​fire, violently besieging several casual cultivators.
The flame ignited immediately when it touched anything, but it did not generate heat but had a chilly air, which forced the casual cultivators to be physically and mentally exhausted.
"No, it's spirit ants! Everyone, be careful!" Another group of people suddenly appeared in the distance. They were the disciples of Lingxiao Shrine. The leader, a male cultivator, had a pale face and uncontrollable fear in his voice.
However, it was already too late at this time. The number of spirit-eating ants was so numerous that it was mind-numbing, and they were coming from all directions like they were covering the sky.
Although the monks and casual cultivators of various sects worked hard to activate their own techniques, fire, thunder, and sword light flashed randomly, and the swarms of spirit-eating ants were turned into ashes in the roar.
Killing one after another, but the number of spirit corrosive ants is so huge that it seems endless. They still attack one after another, and their efforts are like a drop in the bucket.
